prTitle: Add HTML sanitizer for translated message resources
head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33

prOriginalConhecido.nota: Found via gh pr list search on the title (branch is-37428-add-html-sanitizer-for-messages). The PR's single commit is the benchmark head 02f48f77; merged as 5d77e7ea on main, same content.

tps.bug: The theme verifier's HTML and anchor regexes are case-sensitive, so uppercase tags in translations are flagged as illegal HTML by the build.
tps.evidenciaOpus: VerifyMessageProperties.java:139 and :145 compile HTML_TAGS `<[a-z]+[^>]*>` and ANCHOR_PATTERN `</?a[^>]*>` case-sensitively, so an uppercase <B>/<A> is not treated as HTML/anchor and the lowercasing sanitizer output differs, reporting 'Illegal HTML'. No message bundle at head uses uppercase tags, and the effect is a stricter build-time check, so it is a minor robustness point.
tps.evidenciaAstra: VerifyMessageProperties.java:139-145 uses case-sensitive patterns, so uppercase anchors identical in English and translation bypass the preservation logic at lines 150-155. The sanitizer policy excludes anchors (lines 58-61), causing these valid anchors to be removed and reported as illegal HTML at line 111; ThemeVerifierMojo.java:54-55 then fails the build.
